title: Engineering accessible Fe-N sites in polypyrrole-derived catalysts via a dynamic coordination strategy
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01542A, Paper
Kexiang Li, Fancang Meng, Jiahao Li, Huan Wu, Hongbing Jia, Qingmin Ji
This work developed a “dynamic coordination motif” strategy to overcome the dense packing of polypyrrole, engineering a porous Fe-N-C catalyst with highly accessible active sites for superior oxygen reduction reaction.
